role: Public API barrel for Layer 2 perception pipeline: raw camera frames to structured observations for knowledge graph
detail: Exports 40+ types, configs, exceptions, protocols, and implementations for the CANON Layer 2 perception system. Core classes: Frame (input), Detection (YOLO output), TrackedObject (persistent entities), FeatureProfile (color/embeddings), PersistenceResult (validation); DetectionConfig, TrackingConfig, ValidationConfig govern pipeline behavior; YoloDetector and MockDetector provide object recognition; IoUTracker maintains identity across frames; PerceptionPipeline orchestrates end-to-end processing; FrameBuffer and ObservationSessionManager handle buffering/state; PersistenceCheckService validates object matches with compute_match_score; ObservationBuilder and ObservationValidator transform to knowledge-graph format. Lazy imports defer OpenCV, YOLO, numpy to implementation modules (types/config safe to import always). No dependencies loaded at import time.
gotchas: No code logic in barrel, only re-exports; lazy loading defers CV dependencies; all imports from submodules (no local implementation)
